title: Beech seeds

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Beech seeds can be planted using the Cultivator to produce new Beech trees. Once planted, the seeds take a few in-game days to grow to full size. Seedlings require a small amount of space directly around where they are planted; if they do not have enough space they will not grow into full trees.
Prohibited areas (These seeds cannot grow in these Biome/Areas):
• Swamp

Introduction. Beech seeds can be planted using the Cultivator to produce new Beech trees. Once planted, the seeds take a few in-game days to grow to full size. Seedlings require a small amount of space directly around where they are planted; if they do not have enough space they will not grow into full trees.
